review_candidates.title: Regional Vice President
review_candidates.description: At INSPIRE , we know the value of exceptional people. We pride ourselves on providing our employees with growth- and career-oriented succession planning. INSPIRE operates each day in a customer-focused, innovative, and team-based environment. Our people are the primary reason for our success. We provide quality technology, qualified technicians, and a creative vision that enables our clients to effectively communicate at their conferences, meetings, and events-all while focusing on building trusting and lasting relationships through professional and personalized service. We offer a competitive benefits package for full-time employees. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage, Life Insurance, Short-term and Long-term Disability, Paid Time Off / Holiday, 401(k), along with additional voluntary benefits are available to all full-time employees at INSPIRE . We are looking for a Regional Vice President for the West Region. Position Summary The Regional Vice President – West Region is a senior operations leader responsible for the overall performance of hotels and convention centers within the assigned area. This role leads area team members in upholding INSPIRE values and culture, driving operational excellence, and ensuring the highest standards of customer service, technical execution, and team development. Requirements Strong organizational and leadership skills with a dedication to high standards of customer service. Strong understanding of the technical and service aspects of the business. Excellent team attitude and a collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset. Must have 5+ years of DET experience, preferably with INSPIRE. Must reside in the assigned area. Key Responsibilities Operations & Team Leadership Work directly with DETs and staff in all aspects of operations, including sales, organization, venue relations, and quality assurance. Mentor DETs in areas of leadership, management, sales, and customer service. Recruit, select, orient, assign, coach, and discipline employees. Enforce standardized in-house operational procedures. Venue Relations & Business Development Develop and maintain relationships with venue contacts to ensure quality service and satisfaction. Act as first point of contact for venue management. Develop relationships and leads for new hotel properties. In-House Venue Operations Lead all aspects of in-house venue transition operations (start-up), including assisting with proposal phase, inventory, site surveys, staffing, and procedural recommendations. Schedule regular visits to in-house venues for training and evaluations. Financial Oversight Monitor expenses and profitability for each location. Oversee accounting practices, ensuring timeliness and accuracy. Oversee inventory at each location to maintain quality and optimal quantities. Training & Quality Oversee regular employee training in software, inventory/accounting programs, technical skills, customer service, and management development. Monitor the service evaluation process, including responses and follow-up. Additional Additional responsibilities as requested. Benefits INSPIRE Solutions is proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our team members. Eligible employees have access to: Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance 401(k) Retirement Plan with company contribution Short-Term Disability Coverage Long-Term Disability Coverage Application Deadline This position is open until filled. Applications are considered on an as-needed basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted as they are identified. Early submission is encouraged to ensure full consideration. Application Instructions Interested applicants may apply directly through our Careers Page at www.inspiresolutions.com/careers.

review_candidates.description: Company Description CS Group Canada, a subsidiary of CS Group (part of the Sopra Steria Group), is a leader in the development and certification of safety-critical systems in the aerospace, electric, and autonomous driving industries. Joining CS Group Canada means taking part in complex, high-tech projects for some of the most prestigious system manufacturers in North America, while benefiting from competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and flexible work arrangements. Job Description Support the development and consolidation of a corporate Quality Management System (QMS) and Quality Manual across multiple sites and departments. ensuring the organization is prepared to support applicable certification and audit requirements, including ISO/SAE 21434 / UNECE R155-related requirements. Key Responsibilities Assess and consolidate existing QMS practices across sites and functions. Structure and support the development of the corporate Quality Manual. Define documentation governance, templates and common ways of working. Facilitate workshops across Manufacturing, Engineering, Sourcing and IT to clarify processes, responsibilities and cross-functional interfaces. Coordinate with Engineering and Cybersecurity experts to ensure applicable requirements are adequately addressed. Qualifications Hands-on experience developing or implementing Quality Management Systems (QMS). Experience developing Quality Manuals, processes, procedures and governance frameworks. Experience performing QMS gap assessments and preparing organizations for audits/certifications. Experience working in complex, multi-site and cross-functional organizations. Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder-management skills. Ability to independently structure fragmented processes and documentation into a coherent management system. Strong Assets Automotive or manufacturing industry experience. ASPICE knowledge or implementation experience. ISO/SAE 21434 / UNECE R155 knowledge. ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 or similar QMS standards. Additional Information Please note that only selected candidates and Permanent Residents/Canadian Citizens will be contacted. Job Types: Full-time, Permanent CS Group Canada values diversity in the workplace and encourages women, visible minorities, ethnic minorities, aboriginal people, and people with disabilities to apply. Benefits Hybrid Work Industry leading medical, dental, and vision Insurance Access to a telemedicine service RRSP program Personal and sick days Recreation room with pool table and foosball table All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

review_candidates.title: Program Manager - Software Sales
review_candidates.description: Job Description We are looking for a Program Manager to join our Software Sales organization. This person will lead projects, improve processes, and help teams make better use of data. The role requires strong project management skills, experience working with teams across regions, and practical knowledge of tools such as Python, Power BI, and Snowflake. The right candidate can turn a broad goal into a clear plan, keep the work moving, and give leaders and stakeholders an honest view of progress. They should also be comfortable analyzing data and presenting results, recommendations, and proposals. In This Role, You Will Lead Projects and Improve Processes Lead projects that involve teams and stakeholders across the organization. Take ownership of projects from planning through completion. Define the work, assign clear next steps, track progress, and keep projects moving. Identify risks, dependencies, and roadblocks early, then work with the right people to address them. Develop consistent processes for sales teams across regions. Lead changes that affect Software Salespeople and help teams adopt new ways of working. Use project management tools to organize priorities, track commitments, and reduce time spent on manual follow-up. Find practical ways to simplify work, save time, and improve results. Keep Leaders and Stakeholders Informed Give leaders a clear and timely view of project progress, results, risks, and decisions. Keep stakeholders informed about what has been completed, what comes next, and where their support is needed. Make project information easy to find and understand. Raise concerns early and explain their potential effect on timelines or results. Present Plans, Proposals, and Results Present project results, proposals, recommendations, and plans in a clear and concise way. Create and deliver presentations for leaders and other stakeholders. Explain complex topics in language that fits the audience. Use data and evidence to support recommendations. Use Data to Guide Decisions Work with Business Intelligence and data teams to analyze data, identify trends, and answer business questions. Turn analysis into clear recommendations that teams can act on. Help leaders and stakeholders understand what the data means and why it matters. Define and Track Performance Develop and track measures for project results, team performance, and operational efficiency. Create simple ways to monitor progress and make results visible. Use performance data to identify problems and opportunities for improvement. Hold owners accountable for agreed actions and deadlines. Support Continuous Improvement Find ways to reduce manual work and make processes easier to follow. Measure whether process changes save time or improve results. Help teams build better habits around project management and data. Develop onboarding and training that covers processes, tools, and basic data practices. Who You Are You take ownership of your work and follow through on commitments. You know how to bring structure to an unclear problem, build a practical plan, and keep people focused on the goal. You communicate directly and adjust your message to the audience. You are comfortable speaking with individuals, teams, and leaders. You can explain progress, present a recommendation, and ask for the decisions or support needed to move forward. You do not wait until a project is off track to raise a concern. You identify problems early, work through obstacles, and keep stakeholders informed. For This Role, You Will Need At least two years of experience in program or project management in a SaaS or technology environment. Experience serving as the main owner responsible for planning the work, tracking progress, and moving a project toward completion. Practical experience with project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Asana, ClickUp, or similar tools. A record of using project management tools and practices to save time, reduce manual work, or improve execution. Experience giving leaders and stakeholders clear updates on progress, risks, decisions, and results. Experience creating and delivering presentations about project plans, proposals, recommendations, or results. Experience analyzing and presenting data to support business decisions. Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Management, Data Science, Industrial Engineering, or a related field. Experience creating dashboards or conducting data analysis. Experience improving processes in measurable ways, including reducing manual work or saving time. Experience in customer success or software renewals. Our Culture & Commitment to You At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results. We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, vacation and holiday leave. About Us WHY EMERSON Our Commitment to Our People At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration. We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor. At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together. Accessibility Assistance or Accommodation If you have a disability and are having difficulty accessing or using this website to apply for a position, please contact: idisability.administrator@emerson.com . About Emerson Emerson is a global leader in automation technology and software. Through our deep domain expertise and legacy of flawless execution, Emerson helps customers in critical industries like life sciences, energy, power and renewables, chemical and advanced factory automation operate more sustainably while improving productivity, energy security and reliability. With global operations and a comprehensive portfolio of software and technology, we are helping companies implement digital transformation to measurably improve their operations, conserve valuable resources and enhance their safety. We offer equitable opportunities, celebrate diversity, and embrace challenges with confidence that, together, we can make an impact across a broad spectrum of countries and industries. Whether you’re an established professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring possibilities, or a recent graduate with an advanced degree, you’ll find your chance to make a difference with Emerson. Join our team – let’s go! No calls or agencies please.

review_candidates.title: Professionel.le, Ingénierie- Conception de système de commandes de vol secondaires et électriques
review_candidates.description: En fonction du poste, Bombardier offre des politiques de travail flexibles et hybrides. Pourquoi vous joindre à nous? Chez Bombardier, nous concevons, construisons, modifions et entretenons les avions les plus performants du monde pour les individus, les entreprises, les gouvernements et les entités militaires les plus avisés. Nous réussissons à établir les normes les plus élevées grâce à notre approche centrée sur les personnes, et toujours en définissant l'excellence, ensemble. Travailler chez Bombardier signifie offrir ce qu’il se fait de mieux. Chaque jour, vous faites partie d’une équipe qui offre des expériences et des produits de qualité supérieure, repoussant les limites du possible dans notre industrie et au-delà. En priorisant la croissance et le développement des employées, nous permettons à chacune d'atteindre son plein potentiel à sa manière, parce que le meilleur travail se produit lorsque vous êtes libre d'être vous-même et de partager votre expertise unique. Nos avantages sociaux En veillant au bien-être de nos employés, nous proposons un programme d'avantages sociaux complet et compétitif, qui comprend les éléments suivants : Régimes d'assurance (Soins dentaires, soins médicaux, assurance-vie, assurance-invalidité, et plus encore) Salaire de base compétitif Régime d'épargne retraite Programme d'aide aux employés Programme de télésanté Ingénieur professionnel – System de Commandes de vol électriques et commandes de vols secondaire Chez Bombardier Aéronautique, nos collaborateurs travaillent ensemble à faire évoluer la mobilité partout dans le monde, une bonne idée après l’autre. Si vous avez une bonne idée, nous avons l’environnement pour qu’elle devienne un produit unique ou une expérience client exceptionnelle. Vos idées sont notre énergie. En tant que membre de l'équipe du système Commandes de vol électriques et commandes de vol secondaire, le candidat devra participer activement à la définition technique du système d'actionnement. À ce titre, le candidat pourrait être impliqué et/ou responsable d'un bon nombre d'activités. Au début de la prise de poste, ces activités seront principalement associées au programme en service (Challenger, Global Express, Global 8000). Avec plus d’expérience, le candidate participera aux activités de développement en vue de se préparer pour les défis et demandes des futures plateforme comme l’Ecojet. Quelles sont vos contributions envers l’équipe? Jouer un rôle d'intégrateur de système de commande de vols secondaires pour ce qui est de la spécification, la définition, l'analyse, le développement, les essais et la certification de se systèmes. Coordonner les activités de développement de produit des fournisseurs du système, et les interrelations avec les autres systèmes et interfaces (Avionic, Structures, Lois de Contrôle et science du vol.) Assurer la qualité du design, de sa validation, de sa certification, et de sa livraison Assurer l'atteinte des jalons du développement de produit et des livrables de chacune des phases (en tant qu'auteur, vérificateur et approbateur) Résoudre des problèmes techniques dans un environnement multifonctionnel Être impliqué dans la conception et l'intégration des systèmes Revoir la conception et la documentation de tous les aspects des systèmes Vérifier la qualité du contenu des analyses des fournisseurs Valider et vérifier les exigences des systèmes, puis la performance des systèmes par des revues de design, analyses, essais de l'avion et au banc de test Définir, préparer et réaliser des essais de qualification et de certification Collaborer avec les fournisseurs dans l'enquête et la résolution suite aux résultats des tests Préparer ou réviser des rapports de qualification ou de certification Assurer la liaison avec les départements des contraintes, des charges de fiabilité et sécurité RM&S, de simulation, du soutien à la clientèle et aux opérations Identifier des enjeux et obstacles afin de faire le suivi et de communiquer le progrès; Préparer des rapports ou des présentations Voyages occasionnels dans les installations des fournisseurs et les autorités de Certification, ainsi qu'un soutien sur place à la chaîne d'assemblage final (Toronto et Montréal), centre de finitions (Montréal), Centre d’essais en vol (Wichita). Comment vous épanouir dans ce rôle? Vous détenez un diplôme de baccalauréat ou une maîtrise (de préférence) en génie mécanique ou aéronautique avec une expérience pertinente d'au moins cinq (5) ans. Le candidat doit très bien comprendre tous les aspects de la définition, de l'intégration et de la certification d'un système et il doit avoir une bonne connaissance des systèmes et des interfaces de l'avion (par ex. circuits électriques, avioniques). Vous avez une connaissance de base du processus de certification, Partie 25. Vous avez une bonne connaissance de conception mécanique. Une bonne connaissance des dispositifs de commandes des commande de vols serait un atout. Vous avez une bonnes aptitudes pour la rédaction technique et les présentations en anglais sont requises (le français serait un atout). Vous êtes motivé, autonome, organisé, capable de prendre des initiatives et de travailler avec un minimum de supervision. Vous avez l’esprit d’équipe et êtes capable de collaborer avec les fournisseurs et les clients. Vous êtes une personne dynamique, dotée d’un bon sens des responsabilités, de jugement et d’initiative. L'utilisation du genre masculin a été adoptée afin de faciliter la lecture et n'a aucune intention discriminatoire. Bombardier souscrit au principe d'équité en matière d’emploi et encourage les femmes, les autochtones, les personnes handicapées et les membres des minorités visibles à soumettre leurs candidatures. Que votre candidature soit retenue pour la prochaine étape du processus d’embauche ou non, nous vous tiendrons informé par courriel ou par téléphone. Joignez-vous à nous sur carrières.bombardier.com Vos idées mènent le monde. Maintenant que vous vous projetez dans ce rôle, postulez et rejoignez l'équipe Bombardier! Veuillez noter: Vous n'avez pas besoin de toutes les compétences, connaissances et expériences requises pour postuler à ce poste ! Nous ne sommes pas à la recherche du candidat·e parfait·e, mais d'une personne talentueuse et passionnée . Bombardier est un employeur qui souscrit au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi et encourage les personnes de toute race, religion, origine ethnique, identité sexuelle, orientation sexuelle, âge, statut d'immigrant, handicap ou autres caractéristiques protégées par la loi à postuler. Emploi Professionel.le, Ingénierie- Conception de système de commandes de vol secondaires et électriques Site principal BAN Organisation Aerospace Canada Quart de travail Travail de jour Statut de l'employé Régulier Réquisition 15225 Professionel.le, Ingénierie- Conception de système de commandes de vol secondaires et électriques

review_candidates.title: Product Director — Air Systems
review_candidates.description: Vacancy — September 18, 2026 Product Director — Air Systems Responsibilities Own the portfolio. Set the strategy across Scout, Sentinel and Pathfinder — what each platform is for, where they overlap, what gets invested in, what gets a variant and what gets retired. Make the portfolio a coherent set rather than three parallel histories. Own the roadmap and the release decisions. Platform variants, payload options and capability releases, prioritised against operational demand, customer commitments and what production can deliver. Hold the configuration line. Define the common platform and the permitted configuration space, so new customers and new payloads do not each produce a new aircraft. Own the system trade-offs. Endurance, range, payload, signature, survivability, cost and manufacturability — make the calls explicitly, record the reasoning, and keep the company working to one set. Drive the approvals pathway. Own the product side of certification and airworthiness, including beyond visual line of sight (BVLOS) approval in target markets: the evidence, logging, safety-case artefacts and design decisions that make approval achievable rather than aspirational. Design for contested environments. Electronic warfare, jamming and GNSS denial are the operating condition, not an edge case. Own what the aircraft does when the link or the navigation solution degrades. Own the ground segment. Launch and recovery, docking, charging and unattended operation, and the sustainment picture — spares, maintenance intervals, field repair and turnaround time. Integrate air and software as one system. Work with the IRIZI product line and the mission management stack so the aircraft and the software that commands it are designed together, not bolted together. Work with production and supply chain. Match roadmap decisions to manufacturability, component availability and cost at the volumes being committed to. Build the product function. Lead the product team, set how product decisions are made and recorded, and reduce the number of decisions that need the CEO. Represent the portfolio externally. Bids, evaluations, trials, demonstrations and briefings, to operators, programme staff, partners and investors alike. Essential Requirements At least 5 years in unmanned aerial systems, aerospace or a closely comparable engineering-led product environment, including several years owning a product line or portfolio at executive or near-executive level. An engineering background with genuine hands-on depth — aeronautical, mechanical, systems or a related discipline. You must be able to challenge a design decision on the engineering, not only on the schedule. Demonstrated ownership of an air vehicle or major subsystem from concept through flight test into series production and fielded service. Strong grasp of the core trade space: aerodynamics and airframe, propulsion, energy and battery systems, structures and materials, payload integration, and the weight and power budgets that govern all of it. Flight test experience — planning campaigns, reading the data, and turning results into design and product decisions. Working knowledge of airworthiness, certification, NDAA-compliance and the regulatory environment for unmanned flight, including what is required to progress BVLOS approvals. Substantive experience of AI and machine learning in a product context: what models can be relied on to do, how they are evaluated, and where a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer. Experience delivering to defence, security or government customers, including formal evaluation and acceptance. Proven ability to build and lead a product team, and to operate credibly at leadership and board level. Comfortable working with an engineering team and user base operating under wartime conditions. Excellent written and spoken English; willing to travel internationally and work across NATO / EU time zones. Desirable RPAS or manned pilot qualification, or substantial operational flying experience. Military, police or emergency-services background, or sustained close work with those users. Hands-on depth in computer vision, sensor fusion or edge inference on constrained compute. Familiarity with NATO interoperability standards, aerospace assurance practice, and high-rate low-cost production methods. Experience taking a portfolio from one operational customer to multiple export customers, or integrating a product and team after an acquisition.
